transfer delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer before updating the allowance.
approve delegates to the internal _approve.
_transfer ends by calling _tokenTransfer with the computed takeFee flag.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard to perform the accounting.
_tokenTransfer zeroes fee state via removeAllFee before accounting.
_tokenTransfer restores fee state via restoreAllFee after accounting.
_transfer triggers swapAndLiquify before balances are updated, enabling reentrant state observation.
_transfer triggers swapWithoutLiquify before balances are updated.
swapAndLiquify performs an external swap through swapTokensForEth.
swapAndLiquify forwards ETH to fee wallets mid-execution.
swapAndLiquify calls addLiquidity which performs an external payable router call.
swapWithoutLiquify swaps tokens through swapTokensForEth.
swapWithoutLiquify sends the whole ETH balance to fee wallets.
swapTokensForEth invokes the external router swap call.
addLiquidity invokes the external payable addLiquidityETH call.
sendETHToFee performs raw ETH transfers to external addresses.
openTrading calls the external factory createPair.
openTrading seeds liquidity through an external payable call.
openTrading externally approves the pair token to the router.
manualSwapTokensForEth performs the same external router swap call.
manualswap delegates to manualSwapTokensForEth.
manualsend delegates to sendETHToFee.
The external router swap can call back into transfer during fee handling.
The external router swap can re-enter transferFrom while _transfer state is inconsistent.
ETH transfers to fee wallets can re-enter transfer before accounting completes.
The payable router liquidity call can re-enter transfer.
_transferStandard obtains all r/t amounts from _getValues.
_getValues computes fee amounts via _getTValues multiplications and divisions.
_getValues computes reflection amounts via _getRValues multiplications.
_getValues obtains the reflection rate via _getRate division.
_getRate divides rSupply by the supply returned by _getCurrentSupply.
_transferStandard credits team fees via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard subtracts fees through _reflectFee.
_takeTeam increases the contract entry of _rOwned.
_reflectFee decreases _rTotal by the reflection fee.
_reflectFee increases _tFeeTotal by the token fee.
_transferStandard debits sender and credits recipient in _rOwned.
_approve writes the allowance mapping.
balanceOf converts reflections through tokenFromReflection.
tokenFromReflection divides by the rate from _getRate.
_getValues reads the total reflection supply when deriving amounts.
_transfer consults _isExcludedFromFee to decide the takeFee flag.
_transfer gates buy and swap logic on tradingOpen.
_transfer rejects transfers involving blacklisted _bots addresses.
_transfer checks automatedMarketMakerPairs to decide fee applicability.

_transfer compares the contract balance against minContractTokensToSwap.
